evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A definitional contrast that supplies the controlling distinction — informational power via framing the terms, with rational-persuasion logic embedded in the antithesis.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Extends the owned-vs-rented frame into a prescriptive claim about what to retain — informational control of the asset thesis via a reasoned assertion.
